workers.name: analyst
workers.role: reads what the crawler found and writes the short version

workers.name: site
workers.role: pings the public site and fails loudly if it is down

jobs.name: tenders-collect
jobs.goal: have this morning's notices on disk before anyone looks

jobs.name: tenders-brief
jobs.goal: three lines on what is worth a bid

payload.prompt: Read today's notices in ./out and write three lines on what is worth a bid. Write the answer to ./out/brief.md.

jobs.name: tenders-letter
jobs.goal: the weekly letter, which never goes out without a human yes

payload.prompt: Draft the weekly letter from ./out/brief.md into ./out/letter.md. Do not send anything.

jobs.name: site-up
jobs.goal: notice an outage before a client does
